decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed mast and associated equipment cabinets would result in  visually intrusive structures, which would harm the appearance of the street scene and the residential surrounding area, as well as local residential amenity.  This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), and ENV-B.1.7 (Telecommunications) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed mast is considered to be a highly visible and intrusive feature into the river Thames landscape, detrimental to views of the river and affecting this particular historic landscape and listed buildings. This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-B 2.5 Development affecting the setting of a listed building, ENV-W 1.1 Design in the Thames Policy Area, ENV-W 1.3 Important Views and Structures in the Thames Policy Area and ENV-B.1.7 (Telecommunications) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan

Condition : 3 - 3.	The position of the proposed cabinets, and existing lamppost, result in a highway 1.4m wide, which is considered to be inadequate for two persons to pass and the proposed structures thus form an unacceptable obstruction on the public highway, contrary to policy T 2.1 Pedestrian Access of the Unitary Development Plan
description: Installation of a 15m Telecommunications pole with 3 antennas and associated equipment cabinet
